name: Fear of Boof Prepackaged Flower | The Zprite
description: A masterpiece cultivar hunted by Surefire Selections created from the genetic makeup of Lemonade x Triangle Kush BX2. From first inspection the smell is very reminiscent of the legendary Lemon Tree, enhanced with a full-bodied kushiness. Bright, crisp, and organic lemon terps mingle with sugary candy undertones, creating a lemon-lime fizziness reminiscent of cracking open a can of the famous soda. Designed for all-day enjoyment, Zprite delivers an uplifting and balanced high with a unique contrast to other heavier cultivars in the FOB collection.
